findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: audit_restaurant_site · Private data: get_demo_booking_link · Public sink: get_call_benchmarks, estimate_missed_call_revenue, get_demo_booking_link · Destructive: audit_restaurant_site.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: audit_restaurant_site · Private data: get_demo_booking_link · Public sink: get_call_benchmarks, estimate_missed_call_revenue, get_demo_booking_link · Destructive: audit_restaurant_site

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_product_status" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Use when someone asks what Maple offers and which products are available now versus early access or beta: the phone agent, Ordering Sites, Maple GM, Fleet delivery, drive-thru and kiosk. findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
